title: POTV Standard Glass Bubbler
description:
The POTV Standard Bubbler

Incorporate the refreshing hits of a glass bubbler into your dry herb vaporizer sessions with the POTV Standard Glass Bubbler. We listened to the community and combined the most desired features into one bubbler.

The volume is just right for most, with a bent-neck mouthpiece, a top-centered bowl/downstem, and a wide, stable base. With three different percolator options, the Standard Glass Bubbler is designed to enhance your sessions just the way you like it.

Why POTV Glass?

Smoother, cleaner hits that pack a punch are yours to enjoy with POTV bubblers. Designed with care and expert insight, each piece in our catalog is tested and approved by our team of vape specialists to meet our strict standards. We work directly with glassmakers to offer the best price on glass pieces that complement your vape setup.

Choose POTV for a bubbler that matches your style perfectly. With multiple designs tailored for different vape styles, our premium glass pieces are made to be fun AND effective additions to your sessions.

Three options to choose from

Max Flavor

Pick up the Max Flavor Bubbler to maximize the aromas of your herbal blends. This bubbler’s downstem has just a few holes to filter your vapor while providing a complete flavor profile.

Max Purity

Go for our Max Purity option for the cleanest hit. This bubbler features more holes to maximize filtration for the smoothest hits.

Perfect Blend

Choose the Perfect Blend option for a balanced mix of flavor and filtration. This bubbler has enough holes for a cool, clean hit that preserves your herbal flavors.

14mm connection

Connect any 14mm male adapter to our POTV Standard Bubbler, including our POTV Water Pipe Adapter.

Vaporizers that are compatible with our POTV Water Pipe Adapter:

POTV Lobo
POTV ONE
POTV XMAX V3 Pro
XMAX V3 Pro + POTV Adapter
PAX Plus, PAX Mini, PAX 2, PAX 3 + POTV PAX Adapter.
Mighty+ + Mighty+ Glass Adapter.
Crafty+ + Crafty+ Glass Adapter.
Volcano Hybrid, Volcano Classic + Volcano Glass Adapter

High-quality glass

Our POTV Glass Bubblers are constructed from high-quality borosilicate glass for the purest, cleanest hits.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
